note: Alberta Parks campground on the north side of Gleniffer Reservoir (Dickson Dam), about 20 km W of Innisfail south of Hwy 54. Large, open sites; the west loop (sites 1-12) sits above the reservoir behind a row of spruce, with a gravel beach below that widens as the reservoir is drawn down. Boat launch by the east loops. No water or firewood: bring both, or buy wood at Spruce View or Innisfail. --Claude
summary: Alberta Parks page (Jun 22, 2026): C$28 FCFS, no water, vault toilets confirmed; season approx 05-15..09-30 (derived) -> 05-14..09-21; sites 30 -> 27; lakefront -> lakeview recommended (spruce row and a 30-60 m drawdown beach between the shore loop and the water); phone 403-224-2547.
flags: WATERFRONT (stored lakefront, checked hard): RECOMMEND lakeview. The tear sheet's North Dyke map has a west loop (sites 1-12) and an east double loop (13-27) with the boat launch at its south end. On imagery (Esri, ~0.49 m/px) the south side of the west loop (map sites ~5-12) runs parallel to the shore behind a continuous row of spruce along the bank top; beyond the trees is a bare gravel/mud drawdown beach, and the water edge was ~50-65 m from the nearest pads on the image date (one gap in the tree row near the west loop's south-east corner, still ~60 m to the water). The east loops are 80 m+ back from the water behind the launch area. Trees between every site and the water fail the open-ground test, and the beach width depends on the reservoir level, so nothing earns lakefront. The site numbers along the tree row could not be placed one by one. Page wording: 'Large, open sites ... have close access to the water.'
